Subject: reminder intelligibility in the time of clever machines featuring prof ashwin srinivasan
Body: dear all continuing our theme on the th anniversary of the turing test we are pleased to announce our next event in the scai seminar series which will be a panel discussion directly looking at the some of the key ideas behind the test and their contemporary relevance for ai and the humanai relationship we are very fortunate to have prof ashwin srinivasan one of indias foremost ai experts visiting us for this event while his full bio is below in this context i cant resist mentioning that ashwins turing number is he worked alongside donald michie at glasgows turing institute in the early s and donald michie in turn worked alongside alan turing at bletchley park during ww title intelligibility in the time of clever machines keynote speaker prof ashwin srinivasan bits pilani goa discussants prof don dcruz philosophy and prof samar husain linguistics date st october fri time pm venue lh keynote abstract reports suggest that turings test for intelligent machines has been passed for the first time at least times in the past decade we now face the real threat that the progress that has led to success in the imitation gamealong with a host of other longstanding ai challengescan be used straightforwardly into finding new ways to fool us on the positive side it is also thought that these same machines are now intelligent enough to greatly improve our scientific understanding and our engineering capabilities here matters are less clear so far our progress in these areas has involved a combination of human creativity along with mathematical and experimental verifiability while modernday deep learning programs do appear to construct complex internal representations to assist in their computation it is unclear whether these representations refer to conceptual structures we know or correspond to new ones we can understand and use in such a situation machineconstructed insightsif anywill remain a closed book to us assuming we will not be content with a peripheral role in future scientific and engineering progress we need to focus on how we can interact intelligibly with such machines this intelligibility has to work both ways what we know and need will have to be conveyed usefully to the machine and what the machine has discovered or created needs to be conveyed meaningfully to us although i do not see the ability to interact intelligibly as a property of intelligenceit seems to be more one of communicationwe are nevertheless in a time of machines that are clever enough to pass turings test one more time but not clever enough to convey what they know figuratively speaking feigenbaums bottleneck appears to have resurfaced only in reverse keynote bio ashwin is a senior professor at the dept of computer science and information systems at bits pilani goa he received his phd in from the school of electrical engineering and computer science the university of new south wales in ashwin joined the inductive logic programming ilp group at the turing institute scotland and worked on the development and application of inductive logic programming from ashwin was at the oxford university computing laboratory as a postdoctoral researcher then the nuffield trust research fellow in medical mathematics and finally as a university lecturer in computation in he moved to the ibm research – india as a research staff member in he was awarded a ramanujan fellowship by the department of science and technology of the government of india in he took up the post of professor at the newly formed south asian university and became the founder dean of the faculty of mathematics and computer science he was professor of computer science at the iiitd from and moved in jan to bitspilani goa as chair professor from he was the head of the anuradha and prashant palakurthi centre for artificial intelligence research appcair at bits his main research interest is in the application of ai for science using techniques from symbolic and neurosymbolic machine learning thanks sumeet on behalf of scai seminar committee

Subject: civil engineering seminar series dr abhinav gupta from the department of environmental engineering university of cincinnati
Body: dear all you are cordially invited to attend a talk under the civil engineering seminar series by dr abhinav gupta from the department of environmental engineering university of cincinnati scheduled on friday st october at pm in the simulation lab block v room no department of civil and environmental engineering indian institute of technology iit delhi title hydrological modeling for an uncertain future leveraging ai and remote sensing abstract hydrological models simulate quantities such as streamflow soil moisture and suspended sediment concentration these simulations help manage natural resources including water and soil the hydrological models require meteorological data as primary inputs and are calibrated against available hydrological data thus the quality and quantity of hydrometeorological data significantly affect model development furthermore all hydrological models are gross approximations of realworld processes therefore a model must be evaluated rigorously for its fitnessforpurpose the challenge in model evaluation is uncertainty in data which must be quantified for an honest evaluation this talk will discuss a novel method of model evaluation to account for all the uncertainties moreover an example will be provided to show that the dominant uncertainty in hydrological data is epistemic another problem in modeling is a lack or absence of insitu hydrological data in several watersheds across the world one example of a sparsely measured quantity is riverine suspended sediment concentration an important water quality parameter the sparsity problem can be partly addressed by integrating meteorological data with remote sensing data to this end a new algorithm mtanlstm will be presented that can integrate various data sources the talk will conclude with a vision for hydrological modeling where data takes the center stage with due consideration of uncertainties and where the models are seen as scientific hypotheses biography dr abhinav gupta received his phd in in hydrology and hydraulics from the lyles school of civil engineering purdue university his dissertation focused on the quantification of uncertainties in hydrological modeling from to he worked at desert research institute las vegas as a maki postdoctoral associate to develop machine learning models for low flow simulations since he has been a postdoctoral researcher at the university of cincinnati developing regional models to simulate suspended sediment concentration before his phd he worked as an undergraduate researcher at the soil physics lab at the indian institute of technology kharagpur developing machine learning models to estimate soil properties using proximal sensing data all interested are cordially invited to attend the seminar the event will be coordinated by professor rohith an thanks and regards office of the head room no blockiv department of civil and environmental engineering indian institute of technology iit delhi hauz Subject: re talk by dr manish gupta principal applied researcher at microsoft th oct at pm ee committee room
Body: a gentle reminder to attend the talk today at pm at the ee committee room block ii thanks tanmoy original message subject talk by dr manish gupta principal applied researcher at microsoft th oct at pm ee committee room date from tanmoy chakraborty to title multimodal retrieval for visual question answering image search and moment localization time th oct at pm venue ee committee room block ii abstract in this talk i will present recent advancements in multimodal retrieval systems focusing on three distinct and challenging computer vision tasks visual question answering image search and temporal moment localization i will introduce novel frameworks that leverage diverse input modalities including text sketches and video to interpret complex user intent and context first i will talk about retrievalbased visual question answering where the model must perform both a retrieval step over a pool of images and a reasoning step to generate a freeform answer second i will move to the problem of composite sketchtext based image retrieval proposing a new form of multimodal image search for objects that are difficult to name but easy to draw or objects involved in complex hardtosketch interactions finally we will delve into the temporal domain with videotovideo moment retrieval which is a form of moment localization where a query video is used to pinpoint a semantically matching event in a longer target video collectively these works showcase the critical role of developing advanced multimodal systems to handle nuanced retrieval and reasoning challenges across diverse and complex user intents expressed via images and videos bio manish gupta is a principal applied researcher at microsoft he is also an adjunct faculty at iiit hyderabad and a visiting faculty at isb hyderabad he received his masters in computer science from iit bombay in and his phd from uiuc in before this he worked at yahoo bangalore for two years his research interests are in the areas of deep learning natural language processing multimodal nlp and neuroscience he has published more than research papers in reputed refereed journals and conferences he has also coauthored two books one on outlier detection for temporal data and another one on information retrieval with verbose queries thanks tanmoy

Subject: reminder intelligibility in the time of clever machines featuring prof ashwin srinivasan
Body: dear all continuing our theme on the th anniversary of the turing test we are pleased to announce our next event in the scai seminar series which will be a panel discussion directly looking at the some of the key ideas behind the test and their contemporary relevance for ai and the humanai relationship we are very fortunate to have prof ashwin srinivasan one of indias foremost ai experts visiting us for this event while his full bio is below in this context i cant resist mentioning that ashwins turing number is he worked alongside donald michie at glasgows turing institute in the early s and donald michie in turn worked alongside alan turing at bletchley park during ww title intelligibility in the time of clever machines keynote speaker prof ashwin srinivasan bits pilani goa discussants prof don dcruz philosophy and prof samar husain linguistics date st october fri time pm venue lh keynote abstract reports suggest that turings test for intelligent machines has been passed for the first time at least times in the past decade we now face the real threat that the progress that has led to success in the imitation gamealong with a host of other longstanding ai challengescan be used straightforwardly into finding new ways to fool us on the positive side it is also thought that these same machines are now intelligent enough to greatly improve our scientific understanding and our engineering capabilities here matters are less clear so far our progress in these areas has involved a combination of human creativity along with mathematical and experimental verifiability while modernday deep learning programs do appear to construct complex internal representations to assist in their computation it is unclear whether these representations refer to conceptual structures we know or correspond to new ones we can understand and use in such a situation machineconstructed insightsif anywill remain a closed book to us assuming we will not be content with a peripheral role in future scientific and engineering progress we need to focus on how we can interact intelligibly with such machines this intelligibility has to work both ways what we know and need will have to be conveyed usefully to the machine and what the machine has discovered or created needs to be conveyed meaningfully to us although i do not see the ability to interact intelligibly as a property of intelligenceit seems to be more one of communicationwe are nevertheless in a time of machines that are clever enough to pass turings test one more time but not clever enough to convey what they know figuratively speaking feigenbaums bottleneck appears to have resurfaced only in reverse keynote bio ashwin is a senior professor at the dept of computer science and information systems at bits pilani goa he received his phd in from the school of electrical engineering and computer science the university of new south wales in ashwin joined the inductive logic programming ilp group at the turing institute scotland and worked on the development and application of inductive logic programming from ashwin was at the oxford university computing laboratory as a postdoctoral researcher then the nuffield trust research fellow in medical mathematics and finally as a university lecturer in computation in he moved to the ibm research – india as a research staff member in he was awarded a ramanujan fellowship by the department of science and technology of the government of india in he took up the post of professor at the newly formed south asian university and became the founder dean of the faculty of mathematics and computer science he was professor of computer science at the iiitd from and moved in jan to bitspilani goa as chair professor from he was the head of the anuradha and prashant palakurthi centre for artificial intelligence research appcair at bits his main research interest is in the application of ai for science using techniques from symbolic and neurosymbolic machine learning thanks sumeet on behalf of scai seminar committee

Subject: optica student chapter seminar online
Body: title nonlinear interferometers from fundamentals to biomedical imaging and beyond speaker prof markus gräfe experimental solidstate quantum optics institute for applied physics technische universität darmstadt date october thursday time pm pm ist abstract quantum imaging with undetected light is reshaping how we think about measurement detection and the very nature of lightmatter interaction enabled by nonlinear interferometers this remarkable technique allows samples to be probed with one wavelength—tailored for optimal interaction—while performing detection at a completely different and often more efficient spectral range this decoupling of illumination and detection opens up unprecedented pathways for imaging delicate samples exploring new frequency domains and overcoming traditional technological limits in this talk we will journey from the fundamental principles underpinning quantum imaging to its most exciting frontiers including quantum holography and advanced imaging modalities with undetected photons the discussion will highlight how these concepts redefine imaging resolution sensitivity and spectral freedom and will conclude with insights into the scope and limitations of biomedical applications whether your interests lie in quantum optics imaging science or nextgeneration sensing this session will offer both conceptual depth and practical vision for the future of quantumenhanced imaging registration link click here ms teams link click here to join links

Body: dear all the vivekananda study circle under the national resource centre for value education in engineering nrcvee invites all faculty staff students and campus residents of iit delhi to a talk followed by a qa session topic vedanta in daytoday life speaker swami sarvapriyananda ministerincharge of the vedanta society of new york poster date time and venue rd november pm seminar hall iit delhi all guests are requested to take their seats by pm please use the following link to register for the event registration link biography swami sarvapriyananda has been the minister and spiritual leader of the vedanta society of new york since january he joined the ramakrishna math in and received sannyasa in he served as an acharya teacher of the monastic probationers training center at belur math india he also served in various capacities at different educational institutions of the ramakrishna mission in india and as assistant minister of the vedanta society of southern california during and speaker whose works make the insights of advaita vedanta accessible to modern audiences his publications include mahavakya the essence of vedanta fullness emptiness vedanta and buddhism and from illusion to infinity discovering the self the more recent book conversations on vedanta in practice is a curated collection of question and answer sessions with the swami on topics of practical importance the wide range of his writings reflects his deep engagement with comparative philosophy and the application of vedantic wisdom in daily life he has also contributed essays and research papers on the upanishads the bhagavad gita and the philosophy of consciousness regards soumya shubhra nag assistant professor department of electrical engineering indian institute of technology delhi Subject: departmental seminar prof denis thieffry ens institute curie paris th nov pm lh at lhc
Body: dear all we invite you to the ksbs departmental talk on november at pm in lh at lhc the speaker is prof denis thieffry a professor at ecole normale supérieure institut curie psl university paris france please circulate this information in your department all are cordially invited details may be found below speaker prof denis thieffry date th november time pm venue lh lhc title reproducible computational modelling of acute promyelocytic leukaemia resistance to retinoic acid therapy abstract acute promyelocytic leukaemia apl arises from an aberrant chromosomal translocation involving the retinoic acid receptor alpha rara gene predominantly with the promyelocytic leukaemia pml or promyelocytic leukaemia zinc finger plzf genes the resulting oncoproteins block the haematopoietic differentiation program promoting aberrant proliferative promyelocytes retinoic acid ra therapy is successful in most of the pmlrara patients while plzfrara patients frequently become resistant and relapse recent studies pointed to various underlying molecular components but their precise contributions remain to be deciphered in this respect we have integrated the main underlying signalling transcriptional and epigenetic regulatory mechanisms into a mechanistic network model using a logical formalism we have demonstrated that this model captures key features of the apl cell responses to ra depending on the genetic background the explicit inclusion of the histone methyltransferase ezh allowed the assessment of its role in the resistance mechanism distinguishing between its canonical and noncanonical activities the model dynamics was thoroughly analysed using tools integrated in the public software suite maintained by the colomoto consortium the model serves as a solid basis to assess the roles of novel regulatory mechanisms as well as to explore novel therapeutical approaches in silicon speaker bio denis thieffry obtained his phd in at the free university of brussels under the direction of rené thomas and made postdocs in mexico unam germany mpi berlin and belgium univ ghent dt was appointed as full professor of bioinformatics at the university of aixmarseille in france in before moving to paris in to assume the position of professor of systems biology at the ecole normale supérieure ens he is currently associate editor of the journals plos computational biology and nar genomics bioinformatics he has published over articles and book chapters mostly in international journals proceedings and books his current research focuses on the dynamical modelling of the regulatory network controlling haematopoieticimmune cell fate specification and reprogramming in close collaboration with several experimental teams publication list the speaker has also shown interest in interacting with faculty members if anyone is interested please let me know by st november thank you best regards saurabh saurabh raj phd assistant professor kusuma school of biological sciences indian institute of technology hauz khas new delhi india saurabh raj phd assistant professor kusuma school of biological sciences indian institute of technology hauz khas new delhi india

Subject: introducing newly recruited counselloros ms garima
Body: dear all we have a new counselloros who joined iitd in october we welcome her into our iitd family and hope to benefit from her counselling experience and expertise and also wish her all the very best here at iitd a brief biosketch is given under biosketch ms garima ms garima is a dedicated and compassionate psychologist with a strong academic foundation and extensive clinical experience she holds an msc in applied psychology from guru jambheshwar university of science and technology where she specialized in clinical psychology health psychology and guidance counselling psychology to further enhance her professional expertise she pursued a post graduate diploma in counselling and behaviour modification from the same university with over five years of clinical experience working alongside psychiatrists garima has developed deep insight into various psychological disorders and effective intervention techniques she has also completed a post graduate diploma in rehabilitation psychology from the central university of haryana which is recognized by the rehabilitation council of india rci she holds an active rci licence for professional counselling practicegarima has also earned a post graduate diploma in mental health from ignou strengthening her knowledge of mental health care and community wellbeing her professional interests lie in clinical counselling behaviour modification and mental health promotion garima is committed to providing empathetic psychological support and fostering positive change in individuals lives thank you best regards sreedevi dr sreedevi upadhyayula associate dean student affairs student welfare professor class of chair department of chemical engineering indian institute of technology delhi hauz khas new delhi india phone

Subject: department seminar by prof shrihari sridharan on october at pm
Body: dear all we are pleased to announce the mathematics department seminar by prof shrihari sridharan from iiser thiruvananthapuram on october friday at pm the details are given below title from the dynamics of maps to that of correspondences venue room no academic complex west b date and time october friday at pm speaker prof shrihari sridharan abstract in this expository talk we start with a description of dynamics of holomorphic rational maps defined on the riemann sphere and narrate a result concerning the normality of the family of iterates of the map and the equidistribution of inverse images of points we then generalise the same to the setting of holomorphic correspondences explaining our way and motivation from the study of maps to that of correspondences all are cordially invited to attend best regards mathematics department colloquium team

Subject: department seminar by prof souvik pal on october at pm
Body: dear all we are pleased to announce the mathematics department seminar by prof souvik pal from christ university bengaluru on october thursday at pm the details are given below title weakly integrable representations of affine kacmoody algebras venue room no academic complex west b date and time october thursday at pm speaker prof souvik pal abstract in this talk we shall first recall the notion of integrable modules over affine kacmoody algebras after developing the necessary background we shall then introduce the concept of weakly integrable modules in the sense of kacwakimoto and henceforth provide a complete classification of irreducible weakly integrable modules over these lie algebras finally if time permits we shall discuss the analogous classification result for extended affine lie algebras of nullity our results generalize the wellknown work of charipressley concerning the classification of irreducible integrable modules over affine lie algebras all are cordially invited to attend best regards mathematics department colloquium team

Subject: re lecture organized by sathi foundation iit delhi on th october
Body: dear all the sathi foundation iit delhi is organizing a lecture on neuronal communication on the th of october friday at pm the venue is lh the lecture details are as follows title decoding the molecular choreography of synaptic vesicle fusion how neuronal communication achieves its speed name of the presenter dr abhijith radhakrishnan department of cell biology nanobiology institute yale university new haven connecticut usa abstract information processing in the brain is central to cognition and memory at the heart of this lies a fundamental question how do neurons communicate with such speed and precision at their synaptic terminals neurotransmission occurs through the release of neurotransmitters stored in synaptic vesicles although each presynaptic terminal contains numerous vesicles only a select few—those already docked to the membrane forming the “readily releasable pool”—are primed for immediate release upon calcium influx these vesicles can fuse and discharge their contents within a millisecond enabling the synchronous signaling essential for coordinated neural activity despite decades ofresearch into membrane fusion the molecular basis of this exquisite precision hasremained elusive in this talk cryoelectron tomography insights that uncover the supramolecular organization of proteins beneath releaseready vesicles will be presented a strikingly symmetric arrangement of six fusion modules at the docking interface was discovered suggesting that the fusion machinery is prearranged for rapid and reliable neurotransmitter release the findings further reveal how munc an active zone protein and synaptophysin a synaptic vesicle membrane protein guide this ordered assembly building on these structural insights an in vitro lipid bilayer platform has been developed that faithfully mimics synaptic architecture—our “synapse on a grid” visualized by cryo electron tomography this system enables the usage of a reductionist approach to uncover the mechanistic details of synaptic regulation and examine how diseasecausing mutations remodel the fusion machinery offering fresh perspectives on the molecular underpinnings of neurological and developmental disorders short bio dr abhijith radhakrishnan is a structural biologist whose research investigates the molecular mechanisms underlying neurotransmitter release as an associate research scientist in the laboratory of nobel laureate prof james e rothman at yale university he employs cryoelectron tomography to elucidate the structural organization of synaptic fusion complexes his work revealed the hexagonal architecture of these complexes providing a molecular framework for understanding submillisecond synaptic vesicle fusion he received his integrated msc in chemistry from pondicherry university and his phd in chemistry from iowa state university where he used xray crystallography to study the structure and function of integral membrane transport the flyer for the event is attached thanks manidipa manidipa banerjee phd head central research facilities professor kusuma school of biological sciences indian institute of technology delhi hauz khas new delhi Subject: talk by dr manish gupta principal applied researcher at microsoft th oct at pm ee committee room
Body: title multimodal retrieval for visual question answering image search and moment localization time th oct at pm venue ee committee room block ii abstract in this talk i will present recent advancements in multimodal retrieval systems focusing on three distinct and challenging computer vision tasks visual question answering image search and temporal moment localization i will introduce novel frameworks that leverage diverse input modalities including text sketches and video to interpret complex user intent and context first i will talk about retrievalbased visual question answering where the model must perform both a retrieval step over a pool of images and a reasoning step to generate a freeform answer second i will move to the problem of composite sketchtext based image retrieval proposing a new form of multimodal image search for objects that are difficult to name but easy to draw or objects involved in complex hardtosketch interactions finally we will delve into the temporal domain with videotovideo moment retrieval which is a form of moment localization where a query video is used to pinpoint a semantically matching event in a longer target video collectively these works showcase the critical role of developing advanced multimodal systems to handle nuanced retrieval and reasoning challenges across diverse and complex user intents expressed via images and videos bio manish gupta is a principal applied researcher at microsoft he is also an adjunct faculty at iiit hyderabad and a visiting faculty at isb hyderabad he received his masters in computer science from iit bombay in and his phd from uiuc in before this he worked at yahoo bangalore for two years his research interests are in the areas of deep learning natural language processing multimodal nlp and neuroscience he has published more than research papers in reputed refereed journals and conferences he has also coauthored two books one on outlier detection for temporal data and another one on information retrieval with verbose queries thanks tanmoy

Subject: department seminar by prof senthil raani iiser beherampur on october at am
Body: dear all we are pleased to announce the mathematics department seminar by prof senthil raani from iiser berhampur on october thursday at am date and time october at am venue room no academic complex west b title chains in thin sets abstract a longstanding theme in geometric measure theory is the investigation of when thin subsets of euclidean space necessarily contain prescribed geometric configurations a thin set typically means its hausdorff dimension is strictly less than the ambient dimension classical results show that if a set is large in the sense of lebesgue measure or density then it must contain certain configurations in this talk we focus on one such configuration called chains we give a short survey on the recent progress of finding chains in thin subsets of euclidean space and discuss the nature of the existing chains in thin sets all are cordially invited attend best regards mathematics department colloquium team dr ekata saha assistant professor department of mathematics indian institute of technology delhi hauz khas new delhi india

Subject: invitation to the inaugural lecture of the distinguished lecture series on river sustainability organized by center of excellence on water
Body: dear all we are pleased to invite you to the inaugural lecture of the distinguished lecture series on river sustainability organized by the nmcgiitddutch collaboratory for intelligent river systems and clean yamuna center of excellence on water indrivers we will be joined in person by prof venkataraman venkat lakshmi president of the hydrology section american geophysical union and john l newcomb professor department of civil and environmental engineering university of virginia usa he will share his insights on advancing hydrological studies with emerging tools data and methods event details date october time am pm venue senate room iit delhi event poster about the lecture to study land surface hydrology a multitude of toolsmodeling observations and their synergismare required with the availability of novel earth observations at global scales high spatial resolutions and frequent temporal repeats along with artificial intelligence and machine learning aiml techniques especially transfer learning new opportunities emerge for understanding hydrology in ungauged or poorly gaged watersheds the lecture will address four major questions do earth observations compare well with insitu counterparts how important is rainfall in hydrological modeling can we obtain higher spatial resolution of earth observations how do we study ungagedpoorly gaged watersheds about the speaker prof venkataraman venkat lakshmi graduated from the university of roorkee in and earned his phd in civil and environmental engineering from princeton university in he has worked at nasa goddard space flight center and served as cox visiting professor at stanford university and program director for hydrologic sciences at the nsf his research spans catchment hydrology satellite data validation landatmosphere interactions and water resources prof lakshmi is a fellow of asce gsa asa and aaas we look forward to your presence and valuable participation in this session regards coordinators coe indrivers indian institute of technology delhi links

Subject: reminder building wealth and financial resilience with insight precision in growing india
Body: dear all we are pleased to bring an investor awareness workshop to the campus community the details are as follows date time th october today pm venue lh title building wealth and financial resilience with insight precision in growing india abstract in todays dynamic economic environment financial planning has emerged as an essential life skill beyond professional excellence while india stands at the cusp of being one of the fastestgrowing economies in the world individuals and families continue to face the challenge of securing their future amidst uncertainties rising costs and increasing life aspirations the upcoming investor awareness workshop at iit delhi seeks to empower participants with genuine structured aligned knowledge to make informed financial decisions that align with both personal and national growth stories this interactive session conducted by experienced personal financial professionals will focus on practical frameworks to help students faculty and staff envision and execute their longterm financial goals the program will cover a wide spectrum of topics central to financial wellbeing such as understanding the importance of personal financial planning and goal setting the necessity of maintaining an adequate emergency fund for lifes unpredictabilities risk protection through insurance as a foundation for financial security harnessing the power of compounding and disciplined investing exploring the role of mutual funds as efficient wealthbuilding instruments linking personal financial discipline with indias broader economic momentum the session will demystify financial concepts through relatable examples and case studies ensuring participants walk away with actionable insights applicable to everyday decisions special emphasis will be placed on ensuring accountability aligning financial strategies with individual values and fostering resilience against risk at iit delhi where innovation and intellectual rigor shape the future of the nation this workshop will be an opportunity to extend that spirit into the realm of financial empowerment by the end of the seminar participants will not only gain clarity on practical tools but will also appreciate the vital role of financial consciousness in building prosperous households and contributing to indias growth journey bio gopal agrawal b tech mba founderdirector gsa fin ventures mr gopal agrawal is a distinguished punebased amfi registered personal finance professional who has established himself as a trusted finance professional over the past two decades he is currently managing investor assets worth ₹ crores across nearly families through the route of mutual funds and oversees a robust monthly sip portfolio of ₹ crores reflecting the deep confidence that clients place in his financial guidance and wealth creation strategies an engineering graduate who pursued his mba with specialized training in capital markets mr agrawal brings a unique analytical perspective to financial advisory services mr agrawals professional journey spans diverse financial sectors including corporate finance share broking and banking before he found his calling in personal finance in last decade his varied experience across financial services has equipped him with comprehensive market understanding and the ability to navigate complex investment landscapes notably he successfully guided his clients through significant market volatility including the challenging pandemic period of demonstrating his expertise in crisis management and longterm perspective maintenance what sets mr agrawal apart in the personal finance space is his behavioral finance approach which prioritizes understanding client temperament over conventional financial analysis his philosophy centers on the belief that successful wealth creation stems from psychological discipline and temperament alignment rather than shortterm market strategies this approach has earned him recognition as a forwardthinking professional who combines traditional financial wisdom with modern behavioral insights dr makarand upkare dr makarand upkare is a personal finance professional holding the crisil certification in wealth manager ccwm and cisp chartered inheritance succession planner from aafm usa he is also a phd in mathematical modelling from ncl pune with over years of rich experience across industry research academia and financial consultancy he currently serves as professor and financial consultant at pune dr upkare is an expert in personal finance with deep knowledge of advanced wealth management strategies portfolio construction and investment advisory making him a trusted advisor for high networth individuals he has held various academic leadership roles and received multiple accolades for teaching excellence dr upkare has also delivered impactful seminars at premier institutions such as iit bombay iit delhi iit kharagpur and iit kanpur among others his diverse background combines rigorous academic training with practical insights into personal finance enabling him to effectively educate and empower audiences on investing and financial planning thanks regards lalan lalan kumar phd smieee associate professor department of electrical engineering indian institute of technology delhi new delhi india tel url links

Subject: introducing newly recruited counsellor ms kanika l kaushik
Body: dear all we have a new counsellor who joined iitd in october we welcome her into our iitd family and hope to benefit from her counselling experience and expertise and also wish her all the very best here at iitd a brief biosketch is given under biosketch ms kanika l kaushik ms kanika laskar kaushik is a psychologist with over seven years of professional experience spanning clinical organizational and educational domains she holds a masters degree in psychology with a specialization in clinical psychology her professional journey reflects a diverse engagement with mental health she has worked as a consultant psychologist in private practice providing therapy and psychodiagnostics for adolescents and adults and contributed to employee wellness and behavioral health programs at dr shikha sharmas onehealth she was also associated with alpheric consultants pvt ltd where she provided career guidance and emotional support to students and professionals additionally she is empanelled as a psychologist at the delhi high court mediation centre offering psychological support in family and interpersonal conflict resolution her approach integrates traditional psychological frameworks with contemporary practices focusing on emotional resilience mental health awareness and holistic wellbeing her work emphasizes fostering balance personal growth and psychological support across diverse populations note pl note that counsellor preeti has resigned wef this week thank you best regards sreedevi dr sreedevi upadhyayula associate dean student affairs student welfare professor class of chair department of chemical engineering indian institute of technology delhi hauz khas new delhi india phone

Subject: building wealth and financial resilience with insight precision in growing india
Body: dear all we are pleased to bring an investor awareness workshop to the campus community the details are as follows date time th october wednesday pm venue lh title building wealth and financial resilience with insight precision in growing india abstract in todays dynamic economic environment financial planning has emerged as an essential life skill beyond professional excellence while india stands at the cusp of being one of the fastestgrowing economies in the world individuals and families continue to face the challenge of securing their future amidst uncertainties rising costs and increasing life aspirations the upcoming investor awareness workshop at iit delhi seeks to empower participants with genuine structured aligned knowledge to make informed financial decisions that align with both personal and national growth stories this interactive session conducted by experienced personal financial professionals will focus on practical frameworks to help students faculty and staff envision and execute their longterm financial goals the program will cover a wide spectrum of topics central to financial wellbeing such as understanding the importance of personal financial planning and goal setting the necessity of maintaining an adequate emergency fund for lifes unpredictabilities risk protection through insurance as a foundation for financial security harnessing the power of compounding and disciplined investing exploring the role of mutual funds as efficient wealthbuilding instruments linking personal financial discipline with indias broader economic momentum the session will demystify financial concepts through relatable examples and case studies ensuring participants walk away with actionable insights applicable to everyday decisions special emphasis will be placed on ensuring accountability aligning financial strategies with individual values and fostering resilience against risk at iit delhi where innovation and intellectual rigor shape the future of the nation this workshop will be an opportunity to extend that spirit into the realm of financial empowerment by the end of the seminar participants will not only gain clarity on practical tools but will also appreciate the vital role of financial consciousness in building prosperous households and contributing to indias growth journey bio gopal agrawal b tech mba founderdirector gsa fin ventures mr gopal agrawal is a distinguished punebased amfi registered personal finance professional who has established himself as a trusted finance professional over the past two decades he is currently managing investor assets worth ₹ crores across nearly families through the route of mutual funds and oversees a robust monthly sip portfolio of ₹ crores reflecting the deep confidence that clients place in his financial guidance and wealth creation strategies an engineering graduate who pursued his mba with specialized training in capital markets mr agrawal brings a unique analytical perspective to financial advisory services mr agrawals professional journey spans diverse financial sectors including corporate finance share broking and banking before he found his calling in personal finance in last decade his varied experience across financial services has equipped him with comprehensive market understanding and the ability to navigate complex investment landscapes notably he successfully guided his clients through significant market volatility including the challenging pandemic period of demonstrating his expertise in crisis management and longterm perspective maintenance what sets mr agrawal apart in the personal finance space is his behavioral finance approach which prioritizes understanding client temperament over conventional financial analysis his philosophy centers on the belief that successful wealth creation stems from psychological discipline and temperament alignment rather than shortterm market strategies this approach has earned him recognition as a forwardthinking professional who combines traditional financial wisdom with modern behavioral insights dr makarand upkare dr makarand upkare is a personal finance professional holding the crisil certification in wealth manager ccwm and cisp chartered inheritance succession planner from aafm usa he is also a phd in mathematical modelling from ncl pune with over years of rich experience across industry research academia and financial consultancy he currently serves as professor and financial consultant at pune dr upkare is an expert in personal finance with deep knowledge of advanced wealth management strategies portfolio construction and investment advisory making him a trusted advisor for high networth individuals he has held various academic leadership roles and received multiple accolades for teaching excellence dr upkare has also delivered impactful seminars at premier institutions such as iit bombay iit delhi iit kharagpur and iit kanpur among others his diverse background combines rigorous academic training with practical insights into personal finance enabling him to effectively educate and empower audiences on investing and financial planning thanks regards lalan lalan kumar phd smieee associate professor department of electrical engineering indian institute of technology delhi new delhi india tel url links

Subject: audit and withdrawal sem has started ends on
Body: dear students the process of auditwithdrawal for semester is open in the erp system and will remain open till pm on kindly note that audit and withdrawal is not possible for those courses for which the final evaluation has been completed course coordinators approval is not required for course audit or withdrawal kindly complete the auditwithdrawal of courses within the timeline provisions related to auditing courses are applicable only as per the coursesofstudy for ug students and earlier entry students audit is possible upto a limited number of credits for electives only pg students do not get credit for audited courses withdrawal is possible for any course however kindly note that withdrawing from core courses may cause serious complications in your course schedule and might entail a delay in graduation withdrawing from courses which are prerequisites to other core courses can significantly delay your graduation after pm on your audit and withdrawal status for any course cannot be changed once a course is withdrawn you will not get any grade other than w once audited only npnf grades will be possible the nf grade is not eligible for remajors further a course that has not been withdrawn or audited will necessarily be awarded a valid credit grade frequently asked questions i am a pg student can i audit a course ans no if it is a core course yes if it is elective however audited courses do not count towards graduation requirements i am a ug student can i audit a course ans no if it is a core course yes if it is elective ug students and earlier entry students may audit upto a total of credits if you have earned credits ngus are not counted credits waived in lieu of an exchange semester are not counted i am a dual degree student can i audit a course ans see ans and for the ug part a qualified yes for the pg part no what is the pass criterion for an audit course ans this depends on the course policy please check the course policy before you decide on auditing the course also there is no remajor facility for audited courses if in doubt ask your teacher should i withdraw from xxxnnn course ans please check if this is a core course if it is core and you are in btech nd year or earlier avoid withdrawal try to clear the course this semester itself if the course is a prereq for other courses do not withdraw if this is otherwise your last semester withdrawal will delay your graduation by a semester i am already eligible to graduate can i audit beyond the credit limit ans yes please raise a studentgeneralrequest in the request type course audit if credit requirements are complete i have already earned hu credits can i audit my current extra hu course ans yes please raise a studentgeneralrequest i audited many courses during the covidaffected semesters are they counted in the credit limit ans no they are not counted courses audited during the five semesters between jan and may are not counted in the credit audit limit i have already credited sufficient de courses can i audit an extra one ans yes please raise a studentgeneralrequest i am in th year should i withdraw from my btp course ans btp is a core course you need to clear it now i am in ug st year can i withdraw from any course ans withdrawing from any course will make you ineligible for branchchange based on cgpa please note that all st year courses are mandatory and you will have to do them sooner or later postponing st year courses later will disrupt your schedule significantly st year courses have their own timetable that does not gel with other courses also courses like pyp cmp and mep mep will be very difficult to do later on you will not be able to reduce your course load below the minimum limit currently the limit is set as ug msc credits ug probation students credits pg part time and hva students credits fulltime pg credits phd no minimum limit the above limits do not apply if this is your last semester with curriculum review and new course codes for entry students some courses from old curriculum may not be offered in their current form in the coming years if they were not supposed to be offered based on semester plans please do not withdraw from any st year ugmscpg core course as this will create problems in your academic progression the process for course auditwithdrawal in erp is given below in case of any difficulty with the process of auditingwithdrawing a course in the erp system write to process for auditwithdraw request access the student portal from the link login with your institute user id and password go to the auditwithdraw page by clicking on the registration link on the left sidebar select the course you wish to audit or withdraw then click on the corresponding button on the page provide the reason for your request and click on the submit button in case you want to take back your request for course withdraw click undo withdraw this can be done only during the period when the auditwithdraw timeline is open in case you want to take back your request for course audit click undo audit this can be done only during the period when the auditwithdraw timeline is open regards assistant registrar Subject: today mathematics colloquium on october wednesday at m in room no academic complex west b
Body: dear all we are pleased to announce the mathematics department colloquium by prof swadesh kumar sahoo department of mathematics iit indore on october wednesday the details are given below title a hyperbolictype metric beyond classical domains date october wednesday at pm venue room no academic complex west b speaker prof swadesh kumar sahoo abstract we consider a new hyperbolictype metric that extends the classical hyperbolic metric to arbitrary domains in mathbbrn n geq this metric coincides with the hyperbolic metric in balls and halfspaces and surprisingly with the quasihyperbolic metric in all unbounded domains it is bilipschitz equivalent to the hyperbolic metric in simply connected planar domains and to the quasihyperbolic metric in bounded domains using this we characterize uniform domains and john disks we also discuss its geodesics closed curves in multiply connected domains and distortion properties under classical transformations all are cordially invited to attend with best regards mathematics department colloquium team

Subject: reminder spie student chapter talk notice
Body: dear all greetings from the spie student chapter of iit delhi we are pleased to invite you to an engaging lecture by prof anirban pathak the talk will be held in online mode and the details are as follows title lets develop quantum technologies with optical components date th september pm onwards online joining link abstract different types of qubits can be used for the realization of quantum technologies however photonic qubits are essential for quantum cryptography photonic qubits are now used for building photonic quantum computing systems too to realize these aspects of photonic quantum technologies several optical components are used in the labs we will briefly describe the working of those optical components with specific attention to interferometers and lucidly describe the way such optical components can be used to build a programmable photonic quantum computer and provide a means for achieving unconditional security in short it will be a lucid introduction to optical quantum information processing about the speaker prof anirban pathak fnasc is a theoretical physicist he did his phd from visvabharati santiniketan subsequently he was a postdoctoral fellow at the freie university berlin he joined jiit noida in at present he is actively involved in teaching and research related to several aspects of quantum optics and quantum information with a focus on quantum cryptography he is a fellow of the national academy of sciences india nasi institute of electronics and telecommunication engineering iete and optical society of india osi he was a visiting scientist at palacky university czech republic for a long period he is also one of the editors of quantum information processing springernature and quantum review letters at present he leads a Subject: mathematics colloquium on october wednesday at m in room no academic complex west b
Body: dear all we are pleased to announce the mathematics department colloquium by prof swadesh kumar sahoo department of mathematics iit indore on october wednesday the details are given below title a hyperbolictype metric beyond classical domains date october wednesday at pm venue room no academic complex west b speaker prof swadesh kumar sahoo abstract we consider a new hyperbolictype metric that extends the classical hyperbolic metric to arbitrary domains in mathbbrn n geq this metric coincides with the hyperbolic metric in balls and halfspaces and surprisingly with the quasihyperbolic metric in all unbounded domains it is bilipschitz equivalent to the hyperbolic metric in simply connected planar domains and to the quasihyperbolic metric in bounded domains using this we characterize uniform domains and john disks we also discuss its geodesics closed curves in multiply connected domains and distortion properties under classical transformations all are cordially invited to attend with best regards mathematics department colloquium team

Body: dear all this is just a kind reminder for the seminar by dr kaushik renganaath today at pm the talk will be given in the ksbs committee room the details of the talk can be found in the mail below hope to see most of you there best saurabh on saurabh raj wrote dear all we invite you to the ksbs departmental talk on th september at pm in the ksbs committee room the speaker is dr kaushik renganaath a postdoc in the department of medicine at the university of chicago usa please circulate this information in your department all are cordially invited details may be found below speaker dr kaushik renganaath date th september time pm venue ksbs committee room title from variants to mechanisms statistical genomics for complex trait dissection abstract over two decades of genomewide association studies have identified thousands of genetic variants underlying complex traits most lie in noncoding regions and influence gene expression yet the causal relationships between expression and complex traits remain poorly understood in this talk i will present findings from my work integrating transcriptomes and genetically complex growth traits in saccharomyces cerevisiae i discovered thousands of genetic correlations between expression and growth which arose largely from transacting regulatory loci rather than local variation strikingly transregulatory genomic hotspots that affect the expression of numerous genes accounted for particularly large fractions of genetic growth variation and of genetic correlations between gene expression and growth genes with genetic correlations were enriched for similar biological processes across traits but with heterogeneous direction of effect these results reveal how transregulatory hotspots shape cellular states that underlie complex traits i will close by highlighting how i am extending these principles to human disease genomics to identify core disease genes and by outlining future directions to advance populationspecific gene Subject: hss seminar series wednesday september pm
Body: dear all you are all cordially invited to the next hss seminar on wednesday september by prof madhulika banerjee delhi university details are as below and in the attached poster we look forward to seeing many of you there hss seminar series team date september time pm venue committee room ms department of humanities and social sciences th floor main building indian institute of technology delhi speaker madhulika banerjee delhi university chair richa kumar department of huss iit delhi title pluriversal knowledges and the planetary polycrisis balancing the cognitive and the material abstract it is now widely recognized that the urgent responses required by the planetary polycrisis could well come from pluriversal knowledges this is because their epistemologies focus on the balance between humans and nature and rooted in local ecologies their practices foster interdependent sustainable relations of production between humans and nature thus the cognitive manifests in the material such that the cycles of production and regeneration in nature determine that of production by humans the epistemology also governs patterns of consumption and distribution – allowing for the possibility of balance overall this set them distinctly apart from and in terms of ‘sustainability’ superior to capitalist systems of production capitalist systems that entered the ecologies where these knowledge systems had been in practice disrupted the production systems significantly the disruption elicited two kinds of responses the first was that of these knowledge systems mirroring the dominant one and creating their double the second response was more creative drawing upon new technologies of production and distribution systems while trying to to retain their epistemological distinctiveness—that is to remain the other so the challenge was in the balance between the cognitive and the material this paper based on the study of specific initiatives in india will explore in some depth the second of the two abovethat of remaining the other it will examine how this response faced two challenges one is external from the capitalist systems of production consumption and distribution which are challenges of standardization creation of new commodities and scale the other challenge is internal – of deep social and economic hierarchies like caste and gender that are endemic to the societies in which these knowledge systems are practiced yet they have recognized that retaining the distinctive epistemology of the other need not necessitate retaining these hierarchies and inequalities so they have explored paths that include democratization of the practices of these knowledge systems this paper argues that together the pathways generated in response to these challenges offer more equitable and just responses to the polycrisis speaker bio madhulika banerjee is a professor of political science at delhi university her work in the field of politics of alternative knowledge systems such as ayurveda is well regarded she has written extensively on the politics of knowledge and knowledge systems including power knowledge medicine ayurvedic pharmaceuticals at home and in the world’ orient blackswan

Subject: talk by dr prasun k roy scientist g drdo on th september pm
Body: dear all this is a gentle reminder about our upcoming department seminar as part of the ongoing series date time wednesday th september – pm venue room no dmse committee room academic complex west speaker dr prasun k roy scientist g centre for fire explosive and environment safety defence research and development organisation drdo talk title ‘polyurea coating for mitigation of blast and ballistic effects’ dr roy will also be available for interactions in the department during the afternoon please let me know if you are interested in meeting him abstract ‘polyurea coating for mitigation of blast and ballistic effects’ elastomeric sprayon coatings are being advocated as excellent retrofit materials for strategic applications particularly for blast mitigation and ballistic protection the most important properties of polyurea include the ease of application rapid cure time adhesive properties and excellent mechanical properties polyurea undergo massive flexure when subjected to blast and impact thereby absorbing or dissipating the energy arising from dynamic loads polyurea is a reaction product of isocyanate and amine which are sold in the market as a twocomponent system namely ‘side a isocyanate’ and ‘side b amine’ to achieve optimal mechanical properties the formulation of amine resin side b needs to be an optimal blend of ‘long chain amine’ ‘crosslinker’ and chain–extender the quantities of each component need to be optimized which require extensive experimentations a twocomponent system isocyanate prepolymer and amine blend has been developed which can be reacted to form a polyurea coating on any surface the properties of the coating can be tuned by varying the individual components in the amine resin blend the efficacy of the developed polyurea towards blast mitigation has been established through shock tube tests visible reduction in damage was evident when the developed polyurea coating was applied onto the tension side of the concrete tile and subjected to blast loads concrete tiles underwent extensive fragmentation at psi peak pressure coated tiles mm polyurea coating could withstand psi peak pressures polyurea nanofibers have also been developed through electrospinning route references • n iqbal m tripathi s parthasarathy d kumar p k roy polyurea coatings for enhanced blastmitigation rsc adv • m tripathi s parthasarathy pkroy spray processable polyurea formulations jappl polym sci • niqbal m tripathi s parthasarathy pkroy tuning the properties of polyurea by regulating soft segment length jappl polym sci • m tripathi s parthasarathy pk roy mechanically robust polyurea nanofibers processed through electrospinning technique mater today comm bio dr prasun kumar roy is presently working as scientist ‘g’ and is heading the protective clothing and materials group at the centre for fire explosive and environment safety drdo delhi he did his graduation in chemistry from hindu college delhi university followed by a masters degree in chemistry from iit delhi chemistry department followed by mtech and phd both from centre for polymer science and engineering iit delhi he is the recipient of the boyscast fellowship from dst under which he did his postdoctoral research at the royal institute of technology stockholm he has guided phd students and mtech students till date his research interests include development of degradable polymers polymers for blast mitigation and fire protective clothing materials he has international research papers in journals and indian patents to his credit we warmly invite you to join us for this session and look forward to your active participation best regards rohit

Subject: optica student chapter special session prof arka majumdar university of washington
Body: event details title metaoptical encoders for high resolution realtime computer vision speaker prof arka majumdar university of washington date time th september – pm ist mode online abstract light’s ability to perform massive linear operations in parallel has inspired numerous demonstrations of opticsassisted artificial neural networks anns however a clear systemlevel advantage of optics over purely digital anns has not yet been established while linear operations can be optically performed efficiently the lack of nonlinearity and signal regeneration demands highpower lowlatency signal transduction between optics and electronics furthermore the energy required for lasers and photodetectors is often overlooked in energy consumption estimates in this work instead of mapping traditional digital operations to optics we codesigned a hybrid opticaldigital ann operating on incoherent light making it suitable for ambientlight conditions under constant latency and power conditions we identified a lowpowerlatency regime where an optical encoder outperforms a purely digital ann in classification accuracy our optical encoder demonstrates khz operation with only mw of power these findings suggest that optics can be advantageous in applications where lower power and latency are prioritized over peak classification accuracy links registration click here ms teams join here we would be grateful if you could kindly circulate the attached poster and event details to encourage participation from students and staff thank you very much for your continued guidance and support sincerely jagriti ahuja president optica student chapter iit delhi caution this email originated from outside of iit delhi do not click links or open attachments unless you recognize the sender and know the content is safe links

Subject: invitation to avadhana sangama
Body: dear all a gentle reminder for the avadhāna saṅgama starting tomorrow please refer to the event flyer for further details how many lists of items can you recall at once what if the list alsoi ncluded arithmetic questions and their answers maybe but what if we asked you to remember a such lists and to recall them in any order or pick out any particular item on demand sounds unbelievable right do you think it is possible to remember any word or verse or paragraph exactly from any chapter in a book crazy but what if we told you its possible there are people who can remember or even items at once they can recall any verse from the śrī bhagavad gītā or other scriptures they can compose verses and poems extempore solve arithmetic problems and then recollect everything at the end this extraordinary feat is called avadhānaman ancient indian art of multiple concentration where memory creativity and razorsharp focus converge it isnt magic but rather a methodical discipline that has existed for thousands of years in the indian tradition probably for the first time in iits the indian knowledge systems iks project iit delhi is showcasing this remarkable tradition and hosting a workshop where you can experience and start learning it firsthand presenting avadhāna saṅgama unlocking the minds power dates th st september venue seminar hall iit delhi time am pm this is a unique twoday event that will bring alive the brilliance of indias cognitive heritage through day sep live performances experience rare demonstrations of avadhāna including dviśatāvadhānam fold concentration and āgamāvadhānam by esteemed jain munis gītāvadhānam a rare performance where cognitive brilliance meets sri bhagavad gita day sep avadhānam workshop engage with practical exercises and learn tools and techniques to strengthen concentration memory mental agility and inner clarity avadhānam is a living tradition that blends scholarship creativity and deep meditative focus rooted in our rich intellectual heritage avadhānam enhances memory sharpens problemsolving abilities and fosters holistic mental development which is gradually diminishing in the current times this is your chance to witness it experience it and learn it register here before seats are filled join whatsapp group for event updates for more details link is give below warm regards dr nomesh bolia chair professor of Subject: invite fourth dinesh mohan memorial lecture
From: head transportation research and injury prevention centre
Body: dear students and colleagues you are cordially invited to the fourth dinesh mohan memorial lecture being organised by the transportation research and injury prevention centre tripc event details speaker prof sudhir chella rajan indian institute of technology madras title the periurban transport challenge beyond automobility towards access and adaptive governance date tuesday september time pm venue lh lecture hall complex lhc indian institute of technology delhi the lecture will be followed by a panel discussion and then at pm we will gather for high tea please note that this is a public lecture feel free to circulate the invite to your network abstract periurban areas are fuzzy inbetween spaces where cities blur into countryside creating governance vacuums with multiple agencies having overlapping responsibilities but no clear authority these transitional zones face distinct transport challenges as carcentric sprawl systematically excludes vast nondriving communities creating bypasses that isolate large archipelagos of human settlements an adaptive governance framework that emphasises equity and access can be structured around four principles engaging diverse stakeholders at different scales in collaborative decisionmaking systems beyond technocratic planning learning from both local knowledge and technical expertise through formal and informal institutions situating solutions other than automobility within the specific contexts of transitional spaces irregular settlements mixed land uses varied infrastructure and acting through flexible experimental approaches that build adaptive capacity through pilot projects and feedback rather than implementing fixed blueprints while acknowledging that structural constraints often determine whether participatory approaches can actually succeed adaptive periurban transport solutions work at different scales at the community level there are initiatives such as bike couriers at the landscape scale there are grassrootsled food mobility networks and water taxis to serve ecotourism at the commutershed scale paratransit and shared modes are integrated with sustainable landuse planning altogether these solutions emphasise human needs access rather than simply accommodating vehicles or aiming to relieve congestion about the speaker sudhir chella rajan teaches at the department of humanities and social sciences iit madras and serves as a visiting professor in political science and policy studies at elon university he previously served as head of department and founding centre coordinator of the indogerman centre for sustainability at iitm prof rajan holds an interdisciplinary doctorate in environmental science and engineering from ucla his research spans political theory and environmental challenges focusing on democratic innovation in addressing complex socialecological problems including automobile pollution regulation power sector reform climate policy transport equity periurban landscape transformation and corruption his career spans government research consultancies ngos and academia prof rajans latest book a social theory of corruption was published by harvard university press in girish agrawal professor and head transportation research and injury prevention centre ms main building iit delhi hauz khas new delhi india t office front desk w tripciitdacin

Subject: spie student chapter talk prof awanish pandey
Body: dear all greetings from the spie student chapter of iit delhi we are pleased to invite you to an exciting talk by prof awanish pandey the talk will be held in hybrid mode and the details are as follows title chips for outer space and particle colliders radiation challenges for silicon photonics date th september pm onwards venue a opc committee room blockiii online link abstract silicon photonics offers a scalable platform for manufacturing highspeed lowpower and compact integrated optical circuits beyond data communication and computing its potential is increasingly being explored in radiationharsh environments such as nuclear reactors outer space and particle accelerators designing highspeed photonic links for such conditions requires careful consideration as radiation tolerance often comes at the cost of key performance parameters in this talk we will examine the impact of different types of radiation—protons neutrons and xrays—on highspeed modulators with a particular focus on ring modulators we will also discuss potential mitigation strategies to enhance resilience without compromising functionality about the speaker awanish pandey is an assistant professor at the optics and photonics centre opc of iit delhi his expertise lies in integrated photonics where he focuses on manipulating properties of photons using nanoscale semiconductor structures prior to joining iit delhi he served as a senior fellow at cern in switzerland contributing to the design and development of radiation hardened highspeed optical communication links for the large hadron collider he conducted his postdoctoral research at photonics research group prg imec belgium where he evaluated nanophotonic devices for various applications dr pandey earned his phd from the indian institute of science bangalore specializing in silicon photonic device fabrication to ensure your participation we kindly request you to register at please join and bring this announcement to the notice of all interested warm regards soorej thekkeyil president spie student chapter iit delhi

Subject: invitation to avadhana sangama
Body: dear all how many lists of items can you recall at once what if the list also included arithmetic questions and their answers maybe but what if we asked you to remember a such lists and to recall them in any order or pick out any particular item on demand sounds unbelievable right do you think it is possible to remember any word or verse or paragraph exactly from any chapter in a book crazy but what if we told you its possible there are people who can remember or even items at once they can recall any verse from the śrī bhagavad gītā or other scriptures they can compose verses and poems extempore solve arithmetic problems and then recollect everything at the end this extraordinary feat is called avadhānaman ancient indian art of multiple concentration where memory creativity and razorsharp focus converge it isnt magic but rather a methodical discipline that has existed for thousands of years in the indian tradition probably for the first time in iits the indian knowledge systems iks project iit delhi is showcasing this remarkable tradition and hosting a workshop where you can experience and start learning it firsthand presenting avadhāna saṅgama unlocking the minds power dates th st september venue seminar hall iit delhi time am pm this is a unique twoday event that will bring alive the brilliance of indias cognitive heritage through day sep live performances experience rare demonstrations of avadhāna including dviśatāvadhānam fold concentration and āgamāvadhānam by esteemed jain munis gītāvadhānam day sep avadhānam workshop engage with practical exercises and learn tools and techniques to strengthen concentration memory mental agility and inner clarity avadhānam is a living tradition that blends scholarship creativity and deep meditative focus rooted in our rich intellectual heritage avadhānam enhances memory sharpens problemsolving abilities and fosters holistic mental development which is gradually diminishing in the current times this is your open for everybody regardless of a division we will be glad to see you among the participants it starts on friday september utc the contest duration is hours you are allowed to use kotlin only to comprehensive ofac sanctions including belarus cuba iran north korea russia syria or the crimea donetsk or luhansk regions for complete the list please visit this page the round is held in accordance with slightly modified icpc rules the round is unrated the contest will have problems of various levels of complexity you are allowed to only use kotlin to solve these problems participants are ranked according to the number of correctly solved problems ties are resolved based on the lowest total penalty time for all problems which is computed as follows for each solved problem a penalty is set to the submission time of that problem the time since the start of the contest an extra penalty of minutes is added for each failed submission on solved problems ie if you never solve the problem you Body: प्रिय साथीगण प्रतिवर्ष की भांति इस वर्ष भी संस्थान में हिन्दी दिवस के अवसर पर से सितंबर तक हिंदी पखवाड़े का आयोजन किया जा रहा है। इस दौरान कई प्रतियोगिताओं एवं कार्यक्रमों का आयोजन किया जाएगा जिनके विवरण निम्न लिंक द्वारा प्राप्त किये जा सकते हैं लिंक हिंदी पखवाड़ा के शुभारंभ के अवसर पर दिनांक सितम्बर मंगलवार को दोपहर बजे से ‘हिन्दी भाषा का अतीत वर्तमान एवं संभावनाएं’ विषय पर कार्यशाला और प्रेरक व्याख्यान का आयोजन किया जा रहा है जिसमे वक्ता के रूप में प्रो राकेश कुमार उपाध्याय निदेशक भाषा पत्रकारिता विभाग भारतीय जन संचार संस्थानiimc नई दिल्ली को आमंत्रित किया गया है । कार्यक्रम का पोस्टर व विवरण निम्न लिंक पर उपलब्ध है लिंक आप से अनुरोध है कि अपनी व्यस्त दिनचर्या से समय निकालकर उपरोक्त कार्यशाला में सहभागिता कीजिएगा तथा अन्य सहकर्मियों को भी प्रेरित कीजिएगा । सहभागिता के किए पंजीकरण निम्न लिंक के माध्यम से सितम्बर तक किया जा सकता है । लिंक व स्‍टाफ के लिए विद्यार्थीगण के लिए सादर नीरज चौरसिया डॉ नीरज चौरसिया अध्यक्ष हिंदी कक्ष भारतीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान दिल्ली हौज खास नई दिल्ली भारत फ़ोन ईमेल वैबसाइट dr neeraj chaurasia head hindi cell indian institute of technology delhi hauz khas new delhi tel website
